title: Price changes

predict.q: Price is now 26; the firm makes normal profit at 30 units. The market price rises to 43. What does the firm do?

options.s: Keeps output at 30 units and earns more on each one
options.fb: Output 30 is no longer best: the 31st to 40th units each add more to revenue (43) than to cost. Profit is higher at 40.

options.s: Raises output until its MC rises to 43
options.fb: Output rises along MC from 30 to 40; profit = (43 − 28) × 40 = 600.

options.s: Cuts output, as it now earns the same revenue from fewer units
options.fb: Revenue per unit has risen, so each extra unit is worth more, not less. Output rises along MC.

task: Move the **Price** slider to 43 and watch the output and the shaded profit or loss.

target.do: Raise the price to 43, then press Check.

takeaway: Output follows the MC curve. At 43, output is 40 and supernormal profit is 600.
